I've written the screen to `/home/mara/cwe-bench/sibling2/out/screener/7600.json`; I re-checked each cited line against my reads, but I couldn't measure repo size, so `repo_mb` is null.

- **Trust decision:** a Feishu tool is turned on if any one account enables it. When it runs, the account actually picked (from the request, the agent's context or the default) was never checked against its own `tools.<family>` setting. The fix puts that check in `extensions/feishu/src/tool-account.ts`, and passes the setting's name (doc, scopes, wiki, drive, perm) from five tool call sites across 5 files.
- **`pattern_fit`:** A+B. The B part depends on `extensions/feishu/src/channel.ts:955-1023`: the channel-info and member-info message actions call the same chat APIs with no `tools.chat` check. The project doesn't document whether `tools.chat` covers those actions, so whether that route is in scope is unconfirmed.
- **Strongest lever:** the fix is easy to under-scope. App scopes needs its own setting rather than the doc tool's helper, the doc tool's media-size lookup needs the same gate, and the account fallback has to pick an account with the tool enabled rather than throw (a fix that just throws breaks that). There's also an easy reason to dismiss the message-action route: those actions are governed by a separate `actions` config, not `tools.*`.
- **Biggest red flag:** none of the listed flags apply. The main risks are that the B route may not be fair to test, and that `bitable.ts:599-605` already shows the right check to copy.
